framework.name: FHWA Road Safety Audit guidance (incl. FHWA-SA-06-06 lineage)
framework.qualification_note: Federal guidance expressly does not constitute a standard, specification, or regulation [EV-US-007]; states operate their own programs. US practice uses named project phases, never numbered stages.

stages.definition: Pre-construction audit during the planning phase, while design options and alternatives are being explored.
stages.notes: Named phase of the FHWA prompt-list architecture; not a numbered stage.

stages.definition: Pre-construction audit during preliminary engineering/design development.
Pre-construction audit during final/detailed design before construction documents are finalized.

stages.display_name: Work Zone Traffic Control Plan Audit
stages.definition: Audit of traffic control during construction.
Audit after construction but before the roadway opens.

exceptions.condition: US federal guidance defines no numbered audit stages; prompt lists 1–7 are checklist identifiers. One phase-independent eight-step process applies to all phases.

inputs.label: Project information package supplied by the owner/design team
inputs.description: Owner supplies necessary materials; team specifies information it needs; reviewed at start-up meeting.

inputs.label: Drawings/plans appropriate to the phase
inputs.description: Itemized per-phase lists live in FHWA-SA-06-06 Chs. 5–7 and were not verbatim-verifiable this pass — recorded as Unknown rather than invented.

inputs.label: Crash history for the project or existing road
inputs.conditional_on: Required in practice for existing-road audits, where crash patterns are reviewed [EV-US-011]

inputs.label: Operational, geometric and human factors context

outputs.label: Written RSA report of findings presented to the owner/design team
Formal owner response (agreement/disagreement + actions)
outputs.description: Serves as the closure document for the RSA.

audit_questions.text: Does the design accommodate all expected road users, including pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcyclists, and combinations thereof?
audit_questions.source_note: RSA focus may target user groups [EV-US-005]

audit_questions.text: Do known crash patterns on or near the project indicate issues the design should address?
audit_questions.source_note: Issue identification draws on crash data analysis and/or operational/geometric/human factors review [EV-US-011]

audit_questions.text: Where might driver expectation, decision load, or sight distance conflict with the intended operation?
audit_questions.source_note: Human factors review is part of issue identification [EV-US-011]

audit_questions.text: Are there safety-relevant differences between alternatives still under consideration that should inform option selection?

rules.description: The RSA must be performed by a team independent of the project and multidisciplinary in composition; formal report and formal response required.
Field reviews under various conditions are part of the eight-step process (step 4).
Prioritization via frequency×severity matrix is optional; when used, labels travel with the matrix id.

sources.title: Road Safety Audits (RSA) program pages + FHWA Road Safety Audit Guidelines FHWA-SA-06-06
